name: Full Marketing Campaign
description: End-to-end campaign workflow: from brief to published posts. Chains content strategist, copywriter, visual designer, social media manager, and analyst.

config.message: @content_strategist Create a complete marketing strategy for account '{{param.account}}', campaign '{{param.campaign}}'. Objective: {{param.objective}}. Target audience: {{param.target_audience}}. Tone: {{param.tone}}. Platforms: {{param.platforms}}. The workspace has already been initialized. Save strategy.md and update brief.md in the campaign folder. Workspace info: {{step.init.output}}

@copywriter Write {{param.post_count}} posts per platform for this campaign. Account: {{param.account}}, Campaign: {{param.campaign}}. Platforms: {{param.platforms}}. Tone: {{param.tone}}. First read the strategy from marketing/{{param.account}}/{{param.campaign}}/strategy.md, then create individual copy files in the copy/ folder. Strategy summary: {{step.strategy.output}}

@visual_designer Generate visual assets for this campaign. Account: {{param.account}}, Campaign: {{param.campaign}}. Read the strategy and copy files first, then generate: 1 hero banner, platform-specific cards for each post. Save all images to marketing/{{param.account}}/{{param.campaign}}/assets/images/ using the output_dir parameter. Copy summary: {{step.copy.output}}

@social_media_manager Create a 2-week posting schedule for account '{{param.account}}', campaign '{{param.campaign}}'. Platforms: {{param.platforms}}. Read all copy files from marketing/{{param.account}}/{{param.campaign}}/copy/ and create a schedule.json in the schedules/ folder with optimal posting times. Copy summary: {{step.copy.output}}

@campaign_analyst Generate a pre-launch campaign report for account '{{param.account}}', campaign '{{param.campaign}}'. Review all campaign artifacts and write a pre-launch-report.md to the analytics/ folder. Include: campaign overview, content inventory, posting schedule summary, expected KPIs with benchmarks, and success metrics. Schedule: {{step.schedule.output}}
